observations.summary: Libya's National Oil Corporation said on November 23 that an unauthorized group closed a valve on the Sharara crude pipeline, threatening approximately 350,000 barrels/day of production; the pre-existing Hamada closure adds approximately 15,000 barrels/day. Reuters subsequently reported crude flowing again toward Zawiya, suggesting a rapid partial reversal; independently timed restoration and output normalization remain unverified. No evidence links this domestic pipeline dispute to the Benghazi naval attack.
observations.title: Libya NOC reports Sharara pipeline valve closure and substantial production disruption
